make_or_buy_basis: One cut/drill gauge produces all common extruded aluminium equipment rails; local adapters, not rail variants, accommodate equipment.

material_spec.finish_or_protection: anodised/coated cleanable finish with isolated steel fasteners, sealed cut ends and no passenger-facing sharp edges
material_spec.form_factor: locally cut, drilled and deburred OSR-RAIL-42 lengths with end stops, isolating feet, datum marks and captive floating-nut channels
material_spec.governing_standard: released LM3-INT-230 rail/attachment calculation plus aluminium, fire, corrosion, shock/vibration and galvanic-isolation evidence
material_spec.grade_or_part_class: 6063-T6 or equivalent 42 x 18 mm extrusion candidate with 50 mm datum pitch, isolated body feet and floating-nut capture
material_spec.material_family: common extruded aluminium passenger/service datum rail
material_spec.nominal_section: 42 x 18 mm reference section; wall, foot, pitch and nut channel remain controlled drawing dimensions
material_spec.traceability: extrusion batch, finish batch, cut list, drill-gauge record, foot/fastener lot and installed rail survey

joining_methods: fixture tack and weld where structural
process_spec.release_level: v2A drawing-controlled MAKE process; generated traveler is unsigned until build
